decision.title: The QT4 driver for XQ40 (packet )
decision.summary: The QT4 driver runs XQ40 through a temporary XQuery adapter over sxml_xquery_compile, answers module and collection queries, checks serialization assertions, and gains an XQuery slice and per-spec gate rates.

item.p: XQuery adapter (temporary): --spec=XQ40 compiles the test's query as an XQuery main module through xquery_adapter.c (glossary qt4_xquery_adapter): sxml_xquery_compile () and the evaluation of src/xpath.c, behind functions with the signatures of include/sxml/xquery.h named sxml_qt4_xquery_*. It is the one driver file with src/ headers (a PRIVATE include line in the driver's CMakeLists). Packet deletes it and drops qt4_ from the calls. Until 3.10 a prolog gives UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE, an "error" outcome. Params, context items and collection queries stay XPath expressions.

declared="true" (params and $name sources) under XQ40: bound in the dynamic context, not declared by the host (a host declaration of the prolog's name is XQST0049, ). Under XP40 they are declared as before.

Modules: the resource table answers XQUERY_MODULE with the file of a <module> of the test case whose uri is the target namespace: the one whose location equals the hint (as written or absolute), else the one whose file name is the hint's last segment, else the first; resource URI file:///SUITE-PATH. No longer a skip reason. Unused until 3.10/3.11.
Collection queries: each <query> is evaluated (XPath, the test's contexts so far) and its value follows the collection's documents in fn:collection; no longer a skip reason.

Serialization assertions: serialization-matches serializes the value with the query's parameters (the adapter gives XQuery's default, method xml; XPath runs use the same) through sxml_serialize_sequence and applies fn:matches with the flags (letters only) to the text; output that is not UTF-8 fails. assert-serialization-error judges an error raised by the evaluation, else by serializing, like error. assert-serialization (only in comments of the suite) stays unsupported. assert-xml is unchanged (nodes through the adaptive method, which writes nodes as the XML method). Feature is satisfied.

Slices: qt4/xquery-slice runs tests/qt4/xquery-slice.txt (--spec=XQ40, 186 XQ-only cases that pass now, up to four per test set with five or more such passes, spread evenly) against tests/qt4/xquery-slice-baseline.txt (186, only goes up); run-slice-test.cmake takes SLICE_FILE and SPEC. Golden qt4/run_xquery and new cases in run_pass, run_fail cover each new feature.

Report: tools/conformance-report.py writes the gate rate (in_scope_passed / in_scope) per spec and, for XQ40 with an XP40 run in the same directory, the XQ-only rate (run cases whose XP40 outcome is "skip: spec"). run-qt4.sh --spec XQ40 needed no change.

Measured (release, snapshot of c9a0cc6, one process per test set): XP40 29,029 passed before and after (no case changed). XQ40 47,313: 33,374 passed (626 wrong error), 2,037 failed, 6,208 errors, 5,694 not run; gate rate 33,356/41,174 = 81.0 %; XQ-only 4,310/10,723 = 40.2 %; method-* 22/444 run. Errors: 5,969 prolog declarations (3.10), 179 group by/windows (3.8); fails: 1,559 XPST0017 (Phase 2 functions not in that snapshot: fn:parse-csv, unparsed-text, json-doc, parse-uri, path, hash, collection, ...).

sources.source: XP40 and XQ40 passes, gate rate, XQ-only rate and outcomes by cause, one process per test set
